purpose: QA-only review flags from Codex-assisted source/oracle review. No model calls, content/key edits or independent human claims.

flags.reason: Question stem names only an IPv4 /25, omitting the given IP10.12.7.201; the numeric mapping depends on the lesson example. Include the IP in the standalone practice question.
Key is supported by the procedure, but explanation exposes request-local R7/R6 source labels instead of reader-facing citations.

Stem describes increased homework behavior but the second left item contradicts it and supplies no second complete contingency. A reduced frequency alone does not determine the positive/negative axis; clarify both scenarios.

Gloves prevent injury before technical work; no evidence that the technical-work target produces the removal contingency. More efficient work is not the same as increased glove-wearing behavior. Reference and rubric overclaim one label.

Reduced heat is a consequence of turning on cooling, not clearly of the working-more target selected by the key. Improvement in work efficiency alone is insufficient to prove operant reinforcement of that target. Also repeats the earlier MCQ category.

Headphones reduce noise, but the claimed target is work efficiency rather than headphone-wearing. The needed contingent relation and behavior-frequency observation are not established; repeats the previous cloze category.
Answer0 is stated in the same prompt as the condition that the group is a zero group; tautological recall and exposed key make this a weak cloze despite a correct numeric key.
Knowledge key Encoding is supported, but explanation displays technical request-local R1/R3 labels.

Reference correctly distinguishes retrieval failure from absent encoding, but explanation adds that the functions operate independently. Distinct functions do not imply independence; this overclaim is not in the cited source.
